svg.title: Where the monkey-bar motion came from
svg.desc: Results of each motion source for hand-over-hand travel. CMU capture: 0 of 22 hang stretches pass travel. Kimodo: 0 of 8 pass the bar check because the hands stay near 1.1 m while the rungs are at 2.2 m. Our procedural clip passes the gate and the bar check.
svg.text: Hand-over-hand travel: who could do it?
0 pass travel (12 pass idle, 11 pass kip)
3 pass the gate, 0 pass the bar check
1 passes the gate, 0 pass the bar check
travel, idle and kip all pass the gate and the bar check
its hands stay near 1.1 m (grip error about 1 m)
it has no hangs in its training labels, so it ignores the hand pins
